components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household). When false or omitted, such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household (i.e. that have the same last name and address). Owners who
                knowingly share a household - created with 'sharesHousehold' true -
                are assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId>'. Duplicate
                detection is expressed solely through this key: a create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole key exactly matches
                an existing owner's. The household segment is the shared household
                id when the owner belongs to a shared household, otherwise empty.
              type: string
              example: '+61400000001|george.franklin@example.com|a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, gains a further 1
                when the name was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), and is
                capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode (the region derived from the postcode when the owner was
                created). 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read. 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from 'birthDate' measured
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18
                to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no 'birthDate' was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                same day (registration date) as this owner, otherwise false. Used
                to flag an unusually high volume of same-day owner sign-ups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was created as a soft-match of an existing
                owner - it is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while having a different telephone -
                otherwise false. Assigned on creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone) when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and postcode
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household); the owner is then created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            When false or omitted, such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
            Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household (i.e. that have the same last name and address). Owners who
                knowingly share a household - created with 'sharesHousehold' true -
                are assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId>'. Duplicate
                detection is expressed solely through this key: a create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole key exactly matches
                an existing owner's. The household segment is the shared household
                id when the owner belongs to a shared household, otherwise empty.
              type: string
              example: '+61400000001|george.franklin@example.com|a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, gains a further 1
                when the name was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), and is
                capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode (the region derived from the postcode when the owner was
                created). 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read. 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and postcode
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household); the owner is then created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            When false or omitted, such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
            Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household, computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name
                and postcode are therefore assigned the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId>'. Duplicate
                detection is expressed solely through this key: a create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole key exactly matches
                an existing owner's. The household segment is the shared household
                id when the owner belongs to a shared household, otherwise empty.
              type: string
              example: '+61400000001|george.franklin@example.com|a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, gains a further 1
                when the name was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), and is
                capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode (the region derived from the postcode when the owner was
                created). 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read. 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from 'birthDate' measured
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18
                to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no 'birthDate' was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                same day (registration date) as this owner, otherwise false. Used
                to flag an unusually high volume of same-day owner sign-ups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was created as a soft-match of an existing
                owner - it is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while having a different telephone -
                otherwise false. Assigned on creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone) when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
